display_title: My Hunter Can't Be This Cute!
description:
After injuring the village doctor, the hunter is determined to atone for his actions. But when he unknowingly takes a sip of the bitter drink while helping around the doctor's house, his body reacts in an unexpected way. Luckily for him, the doctor is still willing to cure whatever ailments lie within his body.

**Notes:**  
[*My Hunter Can't Be This Cute!*](https://www.mangaupdates.com/series.html?id=184908) is the fifth short stories of series [*The Collected Short Stories Of Joseon Era*](https://www.mangaupdates.com/series.html?id=182855).
